subject: general
question: _____________ is broadly divided into Western Ghats and Eastern Ghats.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deccan plateau.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Deccan Plateau** is explained as the whole **southern peninsula of India south of the Narmada River.**
 
• Deccan plateau is generally divided into** Western Ghats and Eastern Ghats.**
 
• It is a high triangular tableland, surrounded on the** west and east by the Western Ghats and the Eastern Ghats,** sequentially, that meet at the **plateau's southern tip and to the north, across Satpura and Vindhya Ranges.**
 
• **Narmada river and Vindhyan range** splits the Deccan Plateau into two parts. 
 
• Upper part is famous as** central highlands **and lower part is famous as** Deccan plateau.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **​**The** Himalayas** is a mountain range in Asia, dividing the plains of the Indian subcontinent from the** Tibetan Plateau.**
 
• **The northern plain** has been founded by the interplay of the three important river systems,** namely the Indus, the Ganga and the Brahmaputra along with their tributaries.**
 
• **Central Highlands** is a tableland of bumpy surface, from **1500 to 2500 ft above the sea.**
